title: Backend Engineer - Game Security
description:
ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

In this role, you will

  • Directly contribute code and be a code owner for multiple services and code bases
  • Collaborate with the Fortnite, Unreal Engine, and Epic Games Store teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate
  • Work with internal and external UEFN development teams, including well-known brands, to address concerns about asset integrity and information disclosure
  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience building & managing distributed systems, designing APIs, and deploying services (e.g. Kubernetes)
  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

description:
ENGENHEIRO MASTER – MINERAÇÃO – VAGA PREFERENCIAL PARA MULHERES

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

Formação: Engenheiro de Minas

Localidade: Parauapebas/PA

Horário de Trabalho: 8h às 17h

Período de inscrição: de 28/09/2022 a 05/10/2022

Como profissional, você vai...

  • Elaborar modelo matemático para os projetos de geração de valor das minas.
  • Gerar cenários de sequenciamento.
  • Analisar e validar as premissas para a elaboração do modelo de reservas e das cavas finais.
  • Gerar declaração de recursos.
  • Gerar declaração de reserva.
  • Definir cavas finais (modelo matemático).
  • Elaborar design das cavas finais.
  • Gerar premissas necessárias ao plano de fechamento de mina.
  • Responsável pela elaboração do RAL.
  • Desdobrar os objetivos e contexto de negócio para o Planejamento de Lavra na elaboração dos ciclos de planejamento.
  • Buscar oportunidades de atendimento em conjunto com o COI Corredor para atendimento dos objetivos de produção.
  • Validar os planos de mina definidos para os ciclos estratégico e orçamentário;
  • Assegurar a programação das atividades de conservação e desenvolvimento de infraestrutura da mina de acordo com diretrizes dos planos (drenagem, vias de acesso, projetos de cava e pilha, etc).
  • Garantir os alinhamentos e a interface com a áreas operacional e com as geotecnia para desdobrar o programa operacional (plano de chuvas, plano DBG).
  • Selecionar e dimensionar e equipamentos de infraestrutura de mina.
  • Atuar como suporte técnico às áreas operacionais e demais horizontes de planejamento de lavra, conforme solicitado.

Estamos muito felizes por ter alguém como você:

Pré requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência no planejamento e gestão de projetos de geração de valor.
  • Otimização de Cava e sequenciamento LOM.
  • Profundo conhecimento de gerenciamento e análise de banco de dados.
  • Visão sistêmica do planejamento de mina em todos os horizontes.
  • Domínio das técnicas de otimização e design de cava, pilha e infraestrutura de mina.
  • Conhecimento das geociências (geologia, geotecnia, hidrogeologia, processamento; etc.).
  • Conhecimento de direito minerário e meio ambiente.
  • Domínio de soluções de programação de atividades e alocação de equipamentos (Lineup).
  • Domínio de dimensionamento de equipamentos de infraestrutura.
  • Dimensionamento de capacidade operacional e impactos da manutenção (DF, MMTR, MTBF, etc.) e de operação (produtividade, UF, etc.).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Pré requisitos desejáveis:

  • Viabilidade Econômica de Projetos.
  • Conhecimentos em Direito Minerário.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

Solicitamos aos trabalhadores que se vacinem contra a COVID-19 e que apresentem o cartão de vacinação com os dados do imunizante, ou carteira de vacinação digital gerada pelo Conecte SUS.

description:
Join to apply for the Public Cloud Project Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer in global distributed collaboration, with over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet in person a few times a year in interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Public Cloud Project Manager . This role requires customer relationship management and advocacy for Canonical's technical assets. It offers an opportunity for a technologist passionate about Linux and Project Management to develop a career with Canonical. Ideal candidates will have an affinity for software, excellent communication skills, and a passion for technology, working alongside some of the industry's best at Canonical.

The role involves providing account leadership and insight for Canonical's key Tier 1 Enterprise Public Cloud accounts, collaborating with individuals from Software Engineering to Senior Executives. You will manage multiple high-profile projects simultaneously, shaping Statements of Work or similar agreements, managing project lifecycles, and ensuring goals for both Canonical and clients are met. Periodic international travel is required, with travel details varying based on company and program needs.

Location: This role is remote within the Americas region.

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and resources.
  • Identifying and mitigating technical and project risks and issues.
  • Maintaining strong customer focus and collaborating with stakeholders for successful outcomes.
  • Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with clients.
  • Managing delivery schedules of third-party deliverables.
  • Managing cross-organization engineering requests outside existing contracts.
  • Advocating Canonical's technologies to customers.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in IT Cloud, software development project management, or similar roles.
  • Deep understanding of Linux, open source, and the public cloud space.
  • Software engineering experience.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience leading remote, cross-cultural teams and clients.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field.
  • Project Management Certification (e.g., PMP).
  • Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., Scrum Master).
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

What we offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and performance bonuses.
  • Additional benefits including leave, parental leave, wellness programs, travel opportunities, and more.

About Canonical:

Canonical is a pioneering open-source tech firm, publisher of Ubuntu, and a leader in AI, IoT, and cloud platforms. We recruit globally, uphold high standards, and promote a diverse, inclusive workplace. Most colleagues work remotely, reflecting our future-focused approach.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer . We value diversity and provide fair consideration to all applicants regardless of background or identity.

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Marketing Innovations Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Job Description

Your Career

The Senior Director Technical Services - LATAM is a key member of the Palo Alto Networks Technical Services Leadership Team, responsible for leading the post-sales technical services organization in the Latin America (LATAM) region. This role focuses on driving exceptional customer outcomes, ensuring value realization, and fostering operational excellence.

This leader will collaborate closely with sales peers in LATAM to align technical services strategies with regional business objectives and customer needs. They will lead a team of technical experts, focusing on the deployment and adoption of Palo Alto Networks solutions, with a specific emphasis on Prisma Access Browser. This high-visibility, high-impact role reports directly to the VP of Global Technical Services and requires a strategic thinker, exceptional leader, and strong collaborator who thrives in a dynamic environment.

Your Impact

  • Lead the LATAM region's post-sales Technical Services team, focusing on rapid and reliable deployments and customer value realization, tailored to the unique needs of the LATAM market.

  • Collaborate closely with LATAM sales leadership to align technical services strategies with regional sales goals, customer requirements, and market dynamics.

  • Drive initiatives to optimize workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and ensure operational efficiency specifically within the LATAM region, including improving deployment times, resource utilization, and the accuracy of delivery forecasts.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with LATAM customers and executive-level leadership to gain insights and feedback on improving the post-sales experience and ensure customer satisfaction. Lead in critical customer situations within the LATAM region.

  • Tailor the delivery of the global Prisma Access Browser (PAB) deployment team to the specific requirements and nuances of the LATAM market.

  • Build a strong cross-functional interlock and operating cadence with LATAM Sales, Center of Excellence, Product Management, and Technology teams to improve product delivery methodologies, inform product quality, and drive continuous improvement in the region.

  • Own and drive the overall technical services delivery experience for LATAM customers; measure, monitor, and report overall customer outcomes, satisfaction, and drive programs to assure continuous improvement within the LATAM organization and across the customer base in the region.

What You Bring

  • Deep understanding of the LATAM market dynamics and customer expectations.

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholder groups like sales, product development and support teams to drive customer success and achieve regional business objectives.

  • Thought leadership and the ability to anticipate and quickly adapt to changing customer and company needs.

  • Passion for creating diverse teams and a customer obsessed, outcomes focused culture. Ability to inspire and attract the best talent.

  • Ability to create a strategy and align resources to execute. Focus on the long term mission and the ability to create initiatives that scale and solve the big problem that impacts many customers and sets the company up for success.

  • Executive presence; The ability to effectively communicate and influence at every level within the organization and with customers

  • Strategic mindset, ability to scale, strong operational, analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of making major transformational improvements to customer, operational and financial performance.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience leading post sales technical services teams within the LATAM region, including managing diverse, multi-lingual, and multi-cultural teams.

  • Strong understanding of the specific cybersecurity challenges and opportunities in the LATAM market.

  • 15+ years’ experience in a high growth SaaS/Cloud Enterprise Technical Services Organization, or similar experience. Including at least 3+ years in a Director leadership capacity leading worldwide teams.

  • Strong technical background with expertise in cybersecurity domains such as network security and cloud security

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with sales, product, and engineering teams

  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to lead and inspire diverse, global teams

  • Demonstrated experience leading global direct/indirect teams of +100 across multiple languages and cultures

  • Demonstrated experience in process optimization, automation, and leveraging technology to enhance technical deployment.

  • Strong business acumen with experience in managing budgets, resources, and P&L responsibilities

  • Prior experience managing networking or enterprise security product services

  • Estimated travel 30%

  • STEM Bachelor’s Degree required or equivalent experience. Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem-estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 6 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.479 leitos, 8.000 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data and Analytics
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.

  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical needs.

  3. Advocate for and manage funding, including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.

  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’s data landscape.

  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams, leveraging knowledge of both Mondelez business domains and technical expertise.

  7. Think strategically, connecting stakeholder use cases to technology solutions and considering the end-to-end experience.

  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen while proactively managing ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify and execute opportunities leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics, including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.

  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems such as SAP, SAC, and Hyperion is a plus.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgment in all decisions and interactions, aligned with our values, policies, and external regulations.

More about this role

We recognize our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, prioritizing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to break stereotypes and barriers to ensure societal representation within our company. Our Diversity Committee operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, and we are part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. Using a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen, you will help Mondelez’s Finance organization build data and analytics products aimed at an AI-ready future. Your products will serve decision-makers at the highest levels, improving measurement and insight through Mondelez’s data. As demand for data and insights grows within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insights to teams that need them.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  • Management consulting experience is a plus.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  • Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

  • Limited travel up to 20% of the time.

Mondelez International values the well-being of our people and offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid models with remote work options on certain days.

No relocation support is available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We produce, sell, and distribute beloved brands such as Oreo, Lacta, Trident, and many more, in Brazil. Our products are available in over 700,000 points of sale and in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão and Curitiba, and we operate one of the company's 11 global technology centers, dedicated to R&D.

Mondelez International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Buscamos uma pessoa ambiciosa e motivada para se unir ao nosso time comercial no segmento de Construção Civil, a qual durante os meses iniciais trabalhará com foco em entender o negócio, estratégia, organização, tipos de clientes, modelo de vendas e outros tópicos, com o objetivo de ser preparada para gerenciar sua própria carteira de clientes por meio de vendas consultivas, desenvolvimento de contas e novos negócios.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Dentro desta função, suas funções durante os primeiros meses serão focadas no processo de treinamento e acompanhamento da área de vendas de campo. Com o apoio da equipe de vendas da Hilti, você se dedicará a:

  1. Entender como funciona a execução disciplinada e o desenvolvimento de negócios na Hilti
  2. Suporte na identificação e proposição de novas oportunidades de negócios
  3. Participar de discussões sobre as estratégias de negociação das contas, cobrindo as dimensões importantes e mais relevantes
  4. Atuar de forma colaborativa com os membros da equipe nos projetos e atividades que lhe são atribuídas
  5. Visitar clientes dentro das áreas, rotas e itinerários designados. Você poderá estar no canteiro de obras, em fábricas ou em escritórios
  6. Fazer parte da execução das vendas dos produtos, incluindo demonstrações nos canteiros de obras de alguns dos produtos mais inovadores do setor, acompanhados de softwares e serviços pós-venda que fazem parte da marca Hilti

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Graduação Superior Completa em Engenharia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para outra cidade/estado a médio prazo
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado desejável, porém, não excludente
  • Experiência prévia em vendas e gestão de carteira de clientes será um diferencial

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes, e em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

O que oferecemos?

Além do seu salário fixo mensal e variável trimestral, oferecemos:

  • Carro corporativo
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais
  • Convênio com SESC/SENAC
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível
  • Descontos em produtos

title: Software Engineer (Rust)
description:
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

  • Concurrent and Asynchronous Programming: Implement highly concurrent systems in Rust, leveraging async/await and efficient thread management to handle thousands of requests per second;
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize system resource usage, including memory management and throughput maximization, ensuring low latency even under high load;
  • Distributed Caching Management: Develop and maintain efficient caching systems across a globally distributed network, addressing challenges such as consistency and cache invalidation;
  • Upstream Connection Management: Maintain stable and efficient connections with upstream services, including load balancing, automatic reconnections, and backpressure management in large-scale network communication.

Requirements

  • Experience in systems development with Rust and low-level programming;
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS;
  • Familiarity with secure development practices;
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems;
  • Knowledge of version control (Git);
  • Background in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and automation pipelines;

Differentials

  • Experience with Edge/CDN;
  • Experience with TCP sockets and Unix sockets;
  • Familiarity with Internet protocol RFCs;
  • Knowledge of HTTP proxy cache daemons such as Nginx, Caddy, and Envoy;

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company, with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Staff React Native Developer at Poatek, you’ll have the opportunity to impact teammates throughout various stages of their careers. Utilizing React Native is a brand new practice for Poatek and therefore you will be able to help steer the direction of our company and future client relationships based on your experience. You’ll have clear oversight of how engineering runs day-to-day and will influence project outcomes.

We understand our responsibility to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive place within the tech industry, while pushing to make our industry more representative. Because of this responsibility, we need candidates who value diversity and inclusion through their work, team collaboration, or mentorship. So in your cover letter, we encourage you to reflect on diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Responsibilities

  • 13-15+ years of professional programming experience, with at least 8-10 years of experience in React Native development.
  • Confidently and effectively deliver high-quality software by applying critical thinking to products, requirements, and processes.
  • Work closely with clients to influence and steer technical product decisions and business goals.
  • Stay up to date with the landscape of software engineering best practices, tools, and frameworks.
  • Extensive understanding of various software architectures and can adapt/compose solutions to unique problems with sustainable and reusable solutions.
  • Help mentor and coach a project team towards shared goals and outcomes.
  • Navigate difficult conversations by providing constructive feedback to teams and clients.

  • Guide your team to understand and work through changing priorities by bringing positive energy.
  • Communicate and simplify complex highly complex problems in order to foster understanding across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Apply your extensive knowledge and findings at an organizational scale.

Qualifications

  • JavaScript expert skilled in React.js, TypeScript, and experienced in developing mobile applications with React Native.
  • Extensive experience using: Vue.js, Node.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and writing Unit tests.
  • Comfortable working with Android and iOS SDKs.
  • Experience with developing Hybrid applications and PWAs.
  • Able to evaluate and articulate decisions around which framework to use for a particular project.
  • Can articulate how users perceive performance and how to optimize their needs.
  • Deep understanding of the pros and cons of server-side and client-side rendering.
  • Experience as a technical leader to a team of web developers that have built and delivered a large web application.
  • Owned and led the delivery of major features and components.
  • Experience working/communicating with clients and stakeholders while being empathetic to their needs.
  • Contribute sound recommendations on technical architecture and design to your teammates and our clients in a compelling and energetic way.
  • Formal leadership/mentorship experience.
  • Experience using, modifying, and creating development tools that foster efficiency and improve processes.
  • Consider 'big picture' perspectives and can successfully balance business goals and technical constraints.
  • Conduct interviews and participate in the hiring process for your team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong mentoring and leadership skills.

Bonus Points

  • You're just as passionate about Accessibility & Usability as we are.
  • Expertise with advanced automation tools (e.g. virtualization, machine learning-based testing, massive parallelization).
  • Understanding of how to design RESTful APIs that are optimized for responsive, interactive mobile experiences.
  • Appreciation and execution of inclusive responsive UI implementation.
  • A list of emerging technologies we’re interested in: Big Data, Machine Learning, Voice, AR/VR, Security Background, and IoT.
  • You have code samples or a GitHub account to share and while you’re there, check us out!

Even if you don’t have expertise in all of the qualifications listed, we value new perspectives and backgrounds and encourage you to apply. We’re committed to building a diverse company that reflects the diversity of our users. We’re committed to growth-mindset.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  • Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus).
  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities).
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses).
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy.
  • Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games.

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras.

A Amazon está procurando um Líder de Equipe AVS ISM para gerenciar uma equipe de gestores de estoque. Os Serviços para Fornecedores Amazon (AVS) são um conjunto de serviços projetados para ajudar os fornecedores mais estratégicos da Amazon a crescer e oferecer a melhor experiência ao cliente.

Como Líder de Equipe ISM para Serviços de Fornecedores Amazon, você será responsável por gerar impacto em um grande grupo de fornecedores através de uma equipe de ISMs que se reportará a você. Sua prioridade será cumprir nosso compromisso de ajudar os fornecedores a melhorar seu desempenho em métricas-chave do varejo, garantir sua satisfação com o serviço e melhorar continuamente a produtividade de sua equipe.

Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Fornecedores para entender as necessidades dos seus fornecedores e definir as metas e objetivos adequados. Você se reunirá regularmente com os Líderes de Categoria para obter orientação e ajudá-los na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

  1. Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast);

  2. Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  3. Experiência em gestão de produto/categoria, logística, gestão da cadeia de suprimentos, planejamento comercial, consultoria ou áreas relacionadas;
  4. Capacidade de construir relacionamentos efetivos com parceiros-chave;
  5. Inglês avançado (escrito e verbal);
  6. Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes grupos funcionais.

Desejável:

  2. Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);

Position Summary
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.

Position Summary
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.
Role & Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Skills & Experience
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)
Other Highly Desired Skills
  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode
Education
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Your Career

Palo Alto Networks is scaling its world-class strategy organization and looking for Team Manager in the area of security services. Though our security services are successful both in the market as well as at preventing attackers, the landscape is continually changing and in need of innovation leadership. The Palo Alto Networks Strategy function is a focused team that works on our most mission-critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth.

As a Manager, of the renewals Team, your efforts will directly impact the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top-of-mind for our executives, particularly as those relate to key partnerships having strategic value to the business. You will lead initiatives with stakeholders to formulate mutually beneficial and measurable outcomes for technical and business objectives with strategic partners. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, influencing skills and ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Manage the overall day to day renewal operations of assigned direct reportsand districts / regions in the LATAM regions

  • Provide support for renewal escalations and your assigned districts

Your Experience

  • At least 3+years experience in Managing diverse enterprise renewals /sales teams
  • At least 3+ years experience in leading 8-15 people, in the office and remote work environments
  • At least 3+ years Experience in hiring, developing and retaining talent
  • Proven Experience with channel /partner sales models renewals/ upsells
  • Proven to consistently achieve renewal/ sales team goals through your leadership
  • Proven ability to learn new technology quickly, as well as adapt to changing needs
  • Excellent communication skills -the ability to build cross-functional relationships
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills -the ability to work on many projects concurrently
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce.com skills

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: IT System Engineer
description:
About the role

The role of the IT system engineer can be both challenging and rewarding. This role requires strong technical expertise, along with business acumen, interpersonal skills, and a passion for continuous improvement. As a Systems Engineer, you will be a member of a global IT operations team. Your main responsibilities include designing, implementing, and maintaining IT infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, security, and scalability of our systems, as well as participate in on-call team rotations. Your expertise in infrastructure as code, systems infrastructure, cloud technologies, and network infrastructure will be crucial in driving our success.

This is a FULL Remote position so good home internet is required, and hours will be, Monday - Friday between 8:00AM and 5:00 PM in the employee’s time zone.

Key Responsibilities:

•Infrastructure as Code: Develop and manage infrastructure through automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.

•Systems Infrastructure: Implement and maintain virtualization, containerization (Docker), SAN, BDR, and patch/vulnerability management solutions for Windows and Linux

•Cloud: Manage and optimize cloud services, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, and Exchange Online.

•Network Infrastructure: Design and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewall policy, VPNs (point-to-point and site-to-site), SD-WAN, load balancers, ACLs and NSGs

Qualifications:

•Effective communication in English (oral and written).

•3-5 years’ experience as a Systems Engineer or similar role.

•Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Azure CLI).

•Experience with systems infrastructure technologies (virtualization, containerization, Docker, SAN, BDR, patch/vulnerability management).

•Proficiency in cloud services (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, Exchange Online).

•Solid understanding of network infrastructure (routing, switching, firewall policies, SD-WAN, load balancers, VPNs, ACLs, NSGs).

•Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

•Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

•Self-motivated, take initiative and ownership of your duties

•Enjoy working in a collaborative environment, value mentorship, and can balance priorities

•Team player but can also operate independently

Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience with automation and orchestration tools.

•Familiarity with security best practices and compliance standards.

•Experience working in a global team

Será responsável por coordenar as estratégias de sell-out da categoria de lavanderia, enfrentando desafios competitivos frente à concorrência e liderando a execução da renovação de 95% do portfólio até fevereiro de 2026.   • Experiência em empresas reconhecidas pela excelência em Trade Marketing no Brasil, como Ambev, P&G, Unilever, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Heineken, Mondelez, Reckitt e Danone.

title: Golang Software Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, leading the development of 1GLOBAL's entitlement server platform. We are looking for a developer to join the team, working collaboratively to design and implement new services, maintain existing components, and test our applications.
We run a multi-site platform, following strict security requirements, provide the service to customers around the world and manage millions of subscriber profiles. We embrace a highly collaborative and diverse environment, value teamwork, autonomy and hold ourselves accountable for our deliverables and customer success.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-impact features and contribute to the architecture design, focusing on resilience, scalability, security, and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability, and extensive test coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-traffic web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and promote these improvements through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new workflows;
  • Mentor junior team members when necessary and contribute to meaningful code reviews.
  • 2+ years of experience in software development (primarily with Golang);
  • Experience with unit, integration, and E2E testing (test-driven development is a plus);
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming interfaces;
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD workflows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Familiarity with development tools and processes;
  • Understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with an autonomous and motivated mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Power System Engineer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

Landis+Gyr is a leading global provider of integrated energy management solutions. We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. Our innovative and proven portfolio of software, services and intelligent sensor technology is a key driver to decarbonize the grid and helped to avoid around 9 million tons of CO2 in FY 2023. With sales of USD 2.0 billion in FY 2023, Landis+Gyr employs around 6,900 talented people across five continents .

For more than a century, we've been pioneers in energy innovation, and we continue to lead the way toward a more sustainable and efficient energy landscape.

Join us at Landis+Gyr, where we manage energy better!

About the Role
We are looking for a Power System Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud-based utility analytics product with embedded power system functionalities. This role offers the opportunity to be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing and customer support. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to transform market and customer needs into robust software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical guidance to the analytics product development team regarding use cases that require power system functionalities such as power flow, optimal power flow, short circuits, transients, stability, arc flash, harmonics, and grounding.

Collaborate with Product Owners to write clear and comprehensive product specifications for design and software teams.

Work closely with technical leads to ensure adherence to product-related system design guidelines.

Leverage deep technical knowledge to propose innovative solutions addressing steady-state and dynamic behaviors of power distribution systems.

Participate in pre-sales activities, supporting the technical validation of proposed solutions.

Act as a subject matter expert in discussions with clients and partners, addressing queries related to power system analysis within our analytics offering.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Power Engineering. Focus on power distribution, transmission modeling, and analysis (e.g., state estimation, power flow, short circuit analysis, optimization, energy markets) is highly valued.

Experience (2+ years preferred) in electric power engineering, including power system modeling, grid simulations, and operations.

Familiarity with tools for power system studies such as PowerFactory, PSS/E, or equivalent (dynamic and EMT simulation) is a plus.

Experience with software development and scripting (Python preferred) is a strong advantage.

Proven ability to analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into software functionalities.

Ability to work both independently and in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary team environment.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Passion for problem-solving and working in an open, supportive team culture.

We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. #EnergizeYourCareer and join us on our journey towards a greener tomorrow.

  • Obtenção e revisão de resultados : garanta que os objetivos de trabalho sejam alcançados com sucesso. Realize revisões dos processos de trabalho, explore métodos mais eficientes, resuma experiências e acumule percepções valiosas para trabalhos futuros.

  • Métodos de liderança de equipes : capacidade de articular claramente métodos para liderar equipes para o sucesso, com experiência comprovada e replicável em mercados estrangeiros.

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Curitiba. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

// Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

// Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em São Paulo Capital e proximidades.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Fidessa's Trading Support Analysts provide functional support for all customer requests across Fidessa's multi-asset product range. This platform provides high-speed access to global equities exchanges and execution venues and is used by top tier brokers worldwide. Based in São Paulo, this team is part of the Fidessa Global Service Desk and is formed of an enthusiastic mix of individuals with strong technical, functional, and customer service skills, looking for a challenging and varied role in a fast-paced environment.

In order to meet the requirements of the customer base and the diverse needs of the evolving trading landscape, the Trading Support team caters to the immediate needs of our customers, resolving a high percentage of issues independently and liaising with specialist groups within the business and technology to ensure fast resolution of issues that require additional coordination to resolve. In addition to providing real-time phone, chat, and e-mail support, Trading Support Analysts also conduct regular on-site customer visits to provide product training and support for Fidessa users. These visits provide valuable ground-level insight on how customers are using Fidessa services and can be leveraged to introduce solutions that will help improve customer workflows through new and existing Fidessa solutions. Travel will be required but will be typically less than 25% (when things stabilize after post COVID-19).

  • At least 1 year of experience in equities trading operations, including basic knowledge of the equity markets and an understanding of equity business flows. Desired Experience and Competencies

  • Experience supporting Software as a Service platforms.
  • Knowledge of financial software platforms.
  • Spoken and written communication skills in Spanish.

About ION

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. More than 40% of the world’s largest companies use our solutions. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading, and risk.

Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

With 10,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe, ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group.

At ION, we offer careers that provide many opportunities: To invent. To design. To collaborate. To build. To transform businesses and empower people around the world to do more, faster and better than before. Imagine what you can do and experience. This is where you can do your best work.

description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for strategic and operational team-oriented leadership of the physical plant while working collaboratively with third-party service providers that provide services to the university. The Facilities Manager plans, leads, and coordinates the construction of campus facilities with third-party providers, including facility renewal, maintenance, and repair.

Responsibilities

The primary core responsibilities, as indicated below:

  • Develop long- and short-term plans for the construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance of physical plants, collaborating with third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate with third-party service providers to ensure that renovations, repairs, and maintenance are completed in a timely manner and that facilities are in excellent working order.

  • Provide schedule reports and other feedback as necessary on the progress of construction, renovations, repairs, and maintenance.
  • Support the use of technology to enhance operations, improve the campus infrastructure, and reduce energy costs.

  • Provide formal and informal training programs as needed to provide relevant knowledge and skills to plant personnel.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related study, with a preference for a Master’s degree.
  • Five years’ demonstrated experience leading small to large projects.
  • A proven record of leadership in facilities management with budget experience.
  • The ability to lead with both a decisive and consultative style, foster open communications, and proactively build positive relationships.
  • A track record of overseeing the complex construction of campus facilities.
  • A team player who fosters collaboration across the organization and has a commitment to excellence.
  • Physical capacity for prolonged standing, walking and climbing stairs with exposure to outdoor elements.

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

  • Apply comprehensive technical expertise to solve moderate to complex problems by interpreting technical documentation such as aircraft Technical Manuals, Maintenance Information and Action Messages, and all technical guidance provided through government official representatives.
  • Maintain and repair aircraft engine components.
  • Apply technical knowledge of aircraft engine systems in determining equipment malfunctions and use required expertise in restoring equipment condition and/or operation.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • U.S. military technical school or specialized training course is desired, certification of education level is required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700GE-700 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Or A&P license and two (2) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700-GE-701 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Must be in possession of a U.S. Passport with minimum 2 plus year validity and 6 blank pages, and be able to travel internationally.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility Public Trust NAC-I. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility Public Trust NAC-I at this work location.
  • Must be able to obtain Iraq Visa.
  • Must be able to pass CENTCOM Medical requirements for deployment.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft mechanical component troubleshooting, repair procedures, and replacement of parts.
  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft unique tools such as test equipment, torque wrenches, dial indicators, and micrometers.
  • Working knowledge of technical publications and Logistics Information Systems.
  • Able to prioritize workloads to maintain schedules on assigned projects.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Able to lead teams through more complex aircraft relevant tasks.
  • Possess the level of experience to inspect all required aeronautical type maintenance to be performed by Mechanics.
  • The incumbent receives technical guidance, as required, from supervisor or higher-level technician, and may be required to make entries in aircraft logs and records.

Physical Requirements/Working Environment

  • Must be able to walk and stand on level and/or inclined surfaces for extended periods throughout the day.
  • Must be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
  • Must be able to crouch, crawl, grasp or handle objects, use finger dexterity, bend elbow/knee and reach above/below shoulders.
  • May be required to lift heavy objects whose weight may exceed 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to type using a standard keyboard to communicate through e-mail and various software applications.
  • Will handle dirty parts and lubricants.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Must be able to pass a Respirator Physical and Fit Test qualification.
  • May be required to operate power vehicles, machinery, hand tools, ground support equipment, fork lift, etc.
  • Must be able to lift/push/pull minimum of 50 pounds.
  • May work in maintenance shop or outside.
  • Must be able to work in a shop where the environment is drafty, noisy, and dirty.
  • May be exposed to extreme noise from operating equipment.
  • May be exposed to electrical shock hazards or work near moving mechanical parts or vehicles.
